mechanism_claims.claim_text: HE repeats act as a pH-sensitive masking element for arginine-rich cell-penetrating peptide constructs, with lower-pH conditions increasing HeLa cell uptake/surface binding relative to neutral pH.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Cellular uptake/surface binding supports CPP delivery behavior, not antimicrobial killing, anticancer cytotoxicity, membrane permeabilization, or MIC/MBC activity.
